name: Legion Autonomous Arsenal
backstory: Scouts open the account, contact machines close the gap and heavy platforms complete the autonomous column. The arsenal recruits its full roster before considering luxury improvements.
strategy_personality: Low multi-legged scouts, close-range machines, tanks, and heavy platforms make a varied non-humanoid army. Confirm each class against anime model references before producing the roster. Legion units are autonomous war machines with important story-specific control lore; human-piloted Juggernauts are a different category. Keep the chosen machine bodies intact and translate their scale and armament into supported builds rather than copying their story power levels.

source_notes:
**Franchise:** 86—Eighty-Six — anime adaptation  
**Strategy:** Swarm · **Target roster:** 11 robots

**Proposed robots:** Ameise 01; Ameise 02; Ameise 03; Grauwolf 01; Grauwolf 02; Grauwolf 03; Löwe 01; Löwe 02; Löwe 03; Dinosauria 01; Dinosauria 02.

**Direction:** Low multi-legged scouts, close-range machines, tanks, and heavy platforms make a varied non-humanoid army. Confirm each class against anime model references before producing the roster. Legion units are autonomous war machines with important story-specific control lore; human-piloted Juggernauts are a different category. Keep the chosen machine bodies intact and translate their scale and armament into supported builds rather than copying their story power levels.

References: [publisher's Eighty-Six feature](https://dengekitaisho.jp/special/23/eighty-six/?rf=top_b), [secondary Legion class reference](https://86-eighty-six.fandom.com/wiki/Legion).

**Production edition:** 86—Eighty-Six anime Legion model sheets.  
**Catalogue key:** `legion-autonomous-arsenal`
purchasing_plan: Open with slots 1–3; recruit 4 through 11 in slot order. Fund each complete stage-0 loadout and the necessary roster/storage expansion before recruitment. Prioritise the full roster, then stage-1 equipment in slot order. No weapon refinement purchases.

equipment_budget.excludes: Frames, facilities, training, repairs, upkeep, discounts and resale; stage-1 total replaces stage-0 gear and is not a simultaneous equipment inventory.
